description: This file contains unit tests for the BlockedNamespaces class, specifically testing its creation, subscription behavior, and CRUD operations within an Akka actor system environment.

classes.name: BlockedNamespacesTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying the behavior of BlockedNamespaces.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and config before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: startWithDefaultConfig
methods.description: Tests creation and CRUD operations of BlockedNamespaces with default configuration.

methods.name: startWithoutRole
methods.description: Tests creation and CRUD operations of BlockedNamespaces without specifying a role.

methods.name: startWithMatchingRole
methods.description: Tests creation with a matching role role and CRUD operations.

methods.name: startSeveralTimes
methods.description: Tests repeated creation of BlockedNamespaces objects within the same ActorSystem.

methods.name: startWithWrongRole
methods.description: Tests behavior when creating BlockedNamespaces with a wrong role, expecting termination.

methods.name: subscribeForChanges
methods.description: Tests subscribing to changes, adding/removing namespaces, and received updates.

methods.name: testCRUD
methods.description: Helper method to test basic add, contains, and remove operations on BlockedNamespaces.
